field_principles.detector_auroc: BARE float: the verifier-ensemble step-error detection AUROC on the ~0-selection-headroom corpus -- the oracle-distinct discrimination signal (the capstone reads this).
field_principles.detector_auroc_ci95: CI95 of the detection AUROC (5-seed or bootstrap >=2000 resamples) -- the statistical bar for the beats-chance claim.
field_principles.detector_beats_chance: BARE bool: true iff the detection AUROC CI95 lower bound > 0.5 -- the verifier carries discriminating signal where SELECTION cannot express it.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. A detection-AUROC-beats-chance result (the verifier carries oracle-distinct discriminating signal beyond selection) and an honest null (the verifier cannot detect on this ~0-headroom corpus) are BOTH decision-grade.
field_principles.model_specs: The verifier ensemble + the corpus + the selection-headroom-~0 condition + n + seeds; required methodology.
field_principles.n_candidates: BARE int: scored candidate count -- MUST be >= 1000 for a sub-percentage detection claim (sample-size rigor).
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records the cached-candidate + ensemble availability + TRM-stand-down; pre-empts the silent-missing-resource fabrication mode.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for the (stochastic) ensemble scoring + the bootstrap.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the corpus + the ensemble config + the AUROC computation; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.selection_headroom: dict {oracle_at_k, vote_at_1, headroom} -- confirms the ~0 selection headroom so a high detection AUROC is the COMPLEMENT of selection (not double-counting), and a null is 'no detection', not 'no headroom' (FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK guard).
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=false -- a learned/energy detection signal scored against cached candidates, oracle-distinct.
